name: metaball
description: NAMCHE metaball brandmark generator — engine and editor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @namche/metaball && npm run build -w @namche/metaball-react && npm run build -w metaball-editor
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @namche/metaball-react
scripts.test: npm run test -w @namche/metaball && npm run test -w @namche/metaball-react && npm run test -w metaball-editor && npm run verify:skill-links
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @namche/metaball-react && npm run lint -w metaball-editor
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:renderer && npm run typecheck -w metaball-editor
